messages:
Tara Singh: Quick flag  today's interviewer calibration session showed up on calendars an hour later than scheduled for EMEA participants. Several couldn't make it.
Owen Brooks: saw that. My calendar (PDT) shows 10am, but EMEA saw 18:00 instead of 17:00.
Mei Park: likely DST conversion bug in the scheduler microservice. We recently added auto-detect for user tz which might double-apply offset.
Rocio Alvarez: impact: two interviewers missed the live review and we had to run an emergency duplicate calibration 30m later. Recruiting rotation got messaged a lot.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1188  scheduler-timezone-double-offset; assigned to eng-scheduling.
Owen Brooks: short-term: can we re-run a meeting invite with explicit tz parameter (e.g., TZ=Europe/London) so calendars show the correct wall clock time?
Mei Park: yes, I can resend invites using the meeting API with explicit timezone and a non-relative time string. Will do a small script to regenerate invites for today's sessions.
Tara Singh: also need a note in recruiter playbook: when scheduling cross-region calibration, always set explicit IANA tz on the invite.
Rocio Alvarez: long-term: add unit test for tz normalization and audit change that introduced auto-detect logic. We should also add an alert when scheduled_time != calendar_display_time for >5% of attendees.
Mei Park: plan: 1) run invite regeneration script (ETA: 25m) 2) rollback auto-detect flag in scheduler (ETA: 2h) 3) add audit/alert and tests (ETA: next sprint).
Owen Brooks: thanks. I'll message affected interviewers with the re-invite and offer a make-up slot.
RecruitingBot: Auto-scan found 7 affected interviewers. Sending consolidated reschedule + apology.
Tara Singh: after the fix, please confirm so we can mark the incident closed and update the ops-doc.
Mei Park: re-invite script complete, invites resent. Rolling back auto-detect now. Posting PR: github.com/redwood/scheduler/pull/1359  tz-auto-detect-rollback.
ops-bot: INC-2026-1188 status -> in_progress.
Mei Park: rollback deployed to staging; will promote to prod in the 30-min window.
Tara Singh: great, thanks for the quick turn. Adding a one-line checklist to recruiter playbook about explicit IANA timezones for cross-region events.
Owen Brooks: resolved for today's sessions. Closing loop once prod rollback is live.
Mei Park: prod rollback complete. Running post-deploy audit to confirm no further mismatches.
ops-bot: INC-2026-1188 status -> resolved.
